# durantic_mesh_network (Data Source)

Looks up a Durantic mesh network by UUID or name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.

# Look up a mesh network by name.
data "durantic_mesh_network" "prod" {
  name = "prod-mesh"
}

# Mesh networks can also be looked up by UUID.
data "durantic_mesh_network" "by_uuid" {
  uuid = "a8ecf9c8-1721-424d-ba0f-87917dfc03d8"
}

# Put a machine on an existing mesh network.
resource "durantic_machine_config" "gateway" {
  machine_uuid      = data.durantic_machine.gateway.uuid
  mesh_network_uuid = data.durantic_mesh_network.prod.uuid
  role_names        = ["gateway"]
}

data "durantic_machine" "gateway" {
  hostname = "gateway-01"
}

output "prod_mesh_cidr" {
  value = data.durantic_mesh_network.prod.network_cidr
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) Name of the mesh network. Set either `uuid` or `name`.
- `uuid` (String) Unique identifier for the mesh network. Set either `uuid` or `name`.

### Read-Only

- `available_ip_count` (Number) Number of IP addresses still available in the network.
- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the mesh network was created.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this is the account's default mesh network.
- `machine_count` (Number) Number of machines in the mesh network.
- `network_cidr` (String) CIDR block of the mesh network.
- `route_reflector_mode` (Boolean) Whether the mesh network uses route reflector mode.
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the mesh network was last updated.
